step_by_step_reasoning: 1. Identified Amazon Connect at the center of the architecture handling incoming contact flows. 2. Identified the personalized greeting flow: Connect invokes a Lambda function which queries DynamoDB for country-specific greetings and parameters. 3. Identified the conversational AI and multilingual flow: Connect integrates with Lex for intent recognition, Translate for multilingual translation, and Polly for text-to-speech voice generation. 4. Identified the call recording and transcription pipeline: Connect saves audio recordings into S3, which triggers a second Lambda function to start an Amazon Transcribe job, writing final text transcripts back into S3.

nodes.name: Amazon Connect
nodes.notes: Software-defined contact center routing calls and managing contact flows across multiple countries.

nodes.name: Amazon S3
nodes.notes: Encrypted data lake storing audio call recordings and converted text transcripts.

nodes.name: AWS Lambda (Transcribe Trigger)
nodes.notes: Triggered by S3 audio uploads to invoke the Amazon Transcribe job.

nodes.name: Amazon Transcribe
nodes.notes: Converts recorded audio calls into searchable text transcripts.

nodes.name: AWS Lambda (Greeting Lookup)
nodes.notes: Fetches country-specific greetings and operational parameters during contact flows.

nodes.name: Amazon DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores country-specific localized greetings, disclaimers, and business logic data.

nodes.name: Amazon Lex
nodes.notes: Provides natural language understanding and conversational AI capabilities.

nodes.name: Amazon Translate
nodes.notes: Dynamically translates disclaimers and localized text into 21 languages.

nodes.name: Amazon Polly
nodes.notes: Converts translated text into natural-sounding spoken audio in multiple languages.

edges.notes: Connect triggers Lambda to query localized greeting data.
Lambda reads country-specific greetings and parameters from DynamoDB.
Connect routes customer voice input to Lex for natural language processing.
Connect passes localized text and disclaimers to Translate.
Translate passes translated text to Polly for voice synthesis.
Connect writes encrypted call audio recordings to S3.
S3 upload triggers Lambda function for transcription process.
Lambda triggers Amazon Transcribe processing on the recorded audio.
Transcribe outputs finished text transcriptions back into S3 data lake.
